description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU scores for different consistency conditions. The x-axis is labeled “Average Lagging (AL)” and has a linear scale ranging from -1 to 7, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and has a linear scale ranging from 12 to 28, with tick labels at intervals of 2.  A red line, marked with star-shaped markers, begins at approximately ( -1, 23) and increases to approximately (7, 27), exhibiting a generally increasing trend with a slight curve. A blue dashed line, marked with square markers, starts at approximately (-1, 13) and rises to approximately (7, 25), also showing an increasing trend. A purple dashed line, marked with circular markers, begins at approximately (-1, 15) and increases to approximately (7, 26), with a similar increasing trend.
